bio.text: Jeanine Driscoll is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York's 4th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, according to Ballotpedia; she won the June 23, 2026 Republican primary.
She was elected receiver of taxes for Hempstead, New York, in 2019, and was an attorney before that.
She received a B.A. in American government and politics from The Catholic University of America and a J.D. from Fordham University.
